references.title: Museum restored tower and operations front photograph
references.creator: Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum
references.license: Museum website; research viewing only, not redistributed
references.inspection: Full 800 x 800 original displayed in browser. Orange/white bands, three intermediate circular balconies, left spiral stair, broad top octagonal glazed cabin; cream operations frontage, two left garage bays, rounded right bay and smaller rooftop cab.

references.title: Control tower and operations side, 9 May 2022
references.creator: Warren LeMay (w_lemay)
references.inspection: Full original displayed fit in browser: separate small cab forward of tall shaft, side external stair and plain two-storey connector at tower base. Upper cabin outside this photograph crop; museum front establishes it.

dimensions.uncertainty: Sources describe heights differently; intermediate levels, roof and antenna heights are photographic estimates, not surveyed.

era.representation: Restored orange/white exterior as photographed 2022 onward. Not the incomplete 1941 tower.

notes: Local Qualla aerial is used for site context only. Supplemental photographs supply architectural evidence absent from the local gallery. No photographic pixels embedded in model or redistributed.
